mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which tends to increase borrowing and investment, thereby boosting equity prices and S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the 20-day periods following a low FEDFUNDS signal, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a strong labor market, which is typically associated with positive economic growth and higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 does not show positive returns in more than 60% of the 20-day periods following a UNRATE decline below 4%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When both the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) is increasing, it indicates a robust labor market, which is likely to drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 30% of the 60-day periods following a joint UNRATE and PAYEMS signal, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates reduced economic activity, which is likely to lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 40% of the 60-day periods following a GDPC1 slowdown, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) suggests stronger economic activity, which is likely to drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 does not show positive returns in more than 50% of the 20-day periods following an INDPRO increase, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which is likely to boost S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 does not show positive returns in more than 60% of the 5-day periods following a RSAFS increase, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is low and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is moderate, it indicates a supportive monetary policy for equities, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 30% of the 20-day periods following a joint FEDFUNDS and UNRATE signal, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates improved consumer confidence and economic activity, which is likely to drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 does not show positive returns in more than 50% of the 60-day periods following a HOUST increase, the hypothesis is rejected.
